Mechanism: twin-signal-rebate
How: A hard cap limits concurrent keys. The arithmetic shows that when 10 fake identities are divided by the per-operator cap of 2, only 5 live hands remain instead of the full ten.
Cost: A locked bond covers tasks per epoch, and the tide of failures burns funds while increasing wait time for each extra identity, making live hands in the same window the value money cannot buy.
Check: The verifier tests identity uniqueness, not whether the task was done correctly, ensuring the kernel state reflects genuine zephyr activity rather than mere completion metrics.
